entities.summary: Ali Kosh is a small Tell of the Early Neolithic period located in Ilam in west Iran, in the Zagros Mountains. It was excavated by Frank Hole and Kent Flannery in the 1960s. In 2017, Ali Kosh was stratigraphically and chronologically revisited by Hojjat Darabi.
